Scope: Bounded typed MediaWiki table parsing and sanitized HTML rendering; no complete MediaWiki HTML parity claim.

Architecture.ExpansionOrdering: Revision-aware MediaWikiTemplateExpander runs before the existing typed Wikitext block parser.
Architecture.TableParser: MediaWikiWikitextRenderer.Parser recognizes table, row, cell, caption, template, link, and nested-table boundaries.
Architecture.Tokenization: Top-level template/link tracking plus quoted attribute-value tracking preserves structural separators.
Architecture.Rendering: Typed table nodes render through the existing bounded RenderContext and attribute policy.

AuditFindings.Evidence: Existing typed parser handles {|, |}, |-, empty/consecutive row separators, missing closure diagnostics, and balanced output.
! and | markers produce th/td cells; !! and || split inline cells within a row.
Existing bounded tokenization preserves pipes inside balanced {{...}} and [[...]] constructs.
A confirmed tokenizer defect was fixed; quoted pipes after attribute '=' are no longer interpreted as cell boundaries.
|+ renders safe captions; validated class/id/aria-label attributes are emitted and duplicate captions produce a bounded diagnostic with deterministic last-caption-wins behavior.

Allow-listed contextual attributes are encoded and only emitted in supported table/row/cell/caption contexts; event handlers, styles, unsafe URL material, invalid spans, unsupported attributes, and oversized values are rejected or ignored.
Existing revision-aware expansion produces table Wikitext consumed by the normal renderer without a second expansion pass.
Unclosed tables render bounded balanced output with typed diagnostics; existing depth, row, cell, character, attribute, output, cancellation, and diagnostic limits remain active.
Complex continuation, complete contextual attribute semantics, browser layout behavior, and exact whitespace parity remain outside the documented subset.

ConfirmedDefects.Issue: Quoted attribute pipes were split by top-level cell tokenization.
ConfirmedDefects.Correction: Added quote-aware bounded scanning to SplitTopLevel and SplitTopLevelToken.

ConfirmedDefects.Issue: Caption attributes were recognized but discarded.
ConfirmedDefects.Correction: Reused the existing validated TableAttributeSet for safe caption class/id/aria-label output.

KnownLimitations: No exact MediaWiki 1.45 HTML parity claim.
Complex table continuation and full caption/row/cell attribute semantics remain outside the subset.
Historical parity, Cargo/Lua parity, host certification, and migration readiness remain independent gates.
RecommendedNextMilestone: Compare the bounded table subset against independently captured reference HTML without changing production evidence or security boundaries.
